description: The optional import guard leaves the AnyPrecision backend registered even when a required class is unbound. The patch carries this behavior over for ModuleNotFoundError and extends it to other ImportErrors.
trigger: In a fresh process, either AnyPrecision class import fails with an exception caught by the guard, other startup and dataset setup succeed, and an uncached comparison selects load_fn "anyprecision". For the second-import case, model construction must succeed and storage accounting must encounter a module.
expected_behavior: Selecting the unavailable backend reports the import problem before attempting model construction or storage accounting.
actual_behavior: A failure at the first import leaves AnyPrecisionForCausalLM undefined, so load_anyprecision raises NameError at from_quantized. A failure only at the second import leaves AnyPrecisionLinear undefined, so get_storage_info raises NameError on its first module check. Neither path reports the original import exception.

verification.description: Whole-parent-tree search found compare_q_logits.py importing get_test_data and save_tensor from compare_q; its source confirms the import occurs at module scope. Parent searches found no AnyPrecision or any_precision occurrences.
verification.limits: Import failure was not executed. Reach is established for these two evaluation entry points, not for unrelated package workflows or dynamic external callers.

verification.description: The parent search found compare_q.py registering the loader and dispatching it through test_ppl. The adapter's load_anyprecision is the direct caller of its storage helper. compare_q_logits.py imports shared helpers but does not call this loader.
verification.limits: Literal repository search; no external callers or real installed backend were tested.

verification.description: The patched-source harness reproduced both missing-name failures using synthetic import exceptions.
verification.limits: In-memory diff application with stub dependencies, not an installed AnyPrecision or Transformers test.
